item.title: Grace 0.4.0
item.description:
Search, Shuffle, and settings for each playlist.

  • Search the whole library with ⌘F: a panel opens over the window and finds tracks in every playlist by title or file name. Use ↑/↓ and Return to play one, or drag a result onto a playlist to copy it there.
  • Shuffle: plays every track once in random order. With Repeat Playlist on, each pass is reshuffled.
  • Shuffle, Repeat, Auto Advance and the crossfade are now saved for each playlist and switch when you play a track from another one. A message in the middle of the window shows which playlist's settings are in use, and the sidebar marks playlists that shuffle or repeat.
  • Dropping onto a playlist in the sidebar works anywhere on its row, and the playlist under the pointer is highlighted.
